public.text: Agree in principle however the building of foundations that does not develop the expertise to use a proven foundational approach due to lack of local expertise risks locking a particular nation into a static, flawed or out dated foundation
public.suggestedRevision: Would suggest refining the section to reflect this and also the separation of delivery of operational systems versus the conceptual design of ideals which must and should be done informed by global expertise even if it can only proceed under local expertise as advocated. This would fit with the parallel approach to development I have suggested in other sections (unconstrained ideal versus pragmatic operational delivery)
